_README: Triage ledger for find-untested-cores.mjs. Mirrors the divergence scanner's ledger: it records a HUMAN judgment for each census 'gap' so the loop stops re-triaging the same glue every iteration. Keys are repo-relative paths. status: GLUE = DOM/canvas/render shell with no unit-testable logic; STUB = documented placeholder, no logic yet; DELEGATED = real logic lives in an imported/shared module that IS tested (file itself is a thin wrapper/barrel); GAP = genuinely untested LOGIC, acknowledged but not yet locked (stays visible as a known gap). Only GLUE/STUB/DELEGATED are suppressed from the loud 'UNTRIAGED' list. An UNTRIAGED gap = something NEW that deserves a look. Prune an entry when the file gains a direct test (the census warns you) or is deleted.

zanyplans/src/effects.js.note: Canvas overlay render loop (requestAnimationFrame + Math.random draws). No pure/deterministic logic surface.

zanyplans/src/grid-collage.js.note: DOM construction; all logic delegates to tile.js (tileToCount) + media.js (pickMediaKind), both tested. See obs 4864.

zanyplans/src/wheel.js.note: Spin UI glue; the spin/selection math lives in wheel-spin.js (planSpin/selectedFromAngle), which is tested (wheel-spin.test.mjs).

api/whh-daily-watch.js.note: Documented stub. scanForNewListings() returns []; real MLS/Apify scraper not yet wired. Nothing to lock until it lands. See obs 3336.

hunter/worker/cross-tier-matching.mjs.note: Sole export is the DB pipeline computeAndPersistDecisions; the pure math (cosineSimilarity) is imported from cross-tier-core.js, which is tested (cross-tier-core.test.mjs). Clip-name matching imported from selects-crossref.js (also tested).

translation/src/manual-steps.js.note: Sole export is the DOM modal openManualStepsModal; its only pure fn (esc) was consolidated into the shared html-escape.js, which is tested (html-escape.test.mjs + main-escape-delegation.test.mjs).

hunter/worker/build-taste-profile.mjs.note: Supabase+Gemini orchestration (gatherDecisions/synthesizeTaste/storeTasteProfile). The only pure computation, aggregateDecisions, was extracted verbatim to taste-aggregate-core.js, which is tested (taste-aggregate-core.test.mjs, obs 3602).

hunter/worker/build-script-context.mjs.note: Supabase+Gemini batch/synthesis glue (analyzeBatch/synthesizeBatches/runScriptTraining). The pure per-script summary, buildScriptSummary, lives in script-summary-core.js, which is tested (script-summary-core.test.mjs).

api/winchester-state.js.note: HTTP handler (GET/PUT state sync). All logic delegates to tested cores: validateStatePayload from _lib/winchester-validate.js (winchester-validate.test.mjs — incl. the UTF-8 byte cap) and extractStateRow/wantsConcurrencyCheck/shouldReject409 from _lib/winchester-state-core.js (winchester-state-core.test.mjs).

translation/src/workshop/index.js.note: DOM mount (mountWorkshop). Pure Soundbite Workshop logic — countByTheme, formatTcShort, themeColor, resolveAndSortBites — lives in workshop-format.js, which is tested (workshop-format.test.mjs, 40 assertions).

translation/src/chatty-loader.js.note: Floating loader toast: DOM create + setInterval phrase rotation (rotate/updateProgressBar/setText). The small pure bits are guarded (empty phrases -> ['Working on it...'], loaders.size===0 early-return, progress clamped 0..1 with typeof-number+>-1 so explicit 0 is honored) — no extractable deterministic contract worth a lock. Read in full iter#7.
